title: Songs she sang with the Vendome band, including 'I'm In Love With You'
summary: She sang 'If I Could Be With You', 'Trouble in Mind' and 'Blue Because Of You', and recites the lines of 'I'm In Love With You', which she never recorded. She liked the band improvising behind her.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
